articles.title_en: On Russia Day, drones hit an apartment building and two oil refineries in Tatarstan and ignite a fire at a petrochemical plant in the Samara region
articles.lead_en: Ukrainian drones struck two oil refineries in Nizhnekamsk on June 12. The Ukrainian Armed Forces General Staff said the targets were the TANEKO refinery (Tatneft) and TAIF-NK.

articles.title_en: Communist Party lawmaker warns Russia is ‘on the brink of a social explosion’ and demands a ‘clear plan’ to end the war
articles.lead_en: A State Duma deputy from Russia’s Communist Party (KPRF), Vyacheslav Markhayev, has warned that Russia is “on the brink of a social explosion,” for which “the entrenched leadership will bear full responsibility.”

articles.title_en: City in Tatarstan cancels Russia Day events after drone hits apartment building. Ukrainian Telegram channels report fire at oil refinery.
articles.lead_en: Ukrainian drones struck the Republic of Tatarstan overnight, hitting industrial facilities and at least one apartment building, regional head Rustam Minnikhanov said. The republic’s prime minister traveled to the scene, he added.

articles.title_en: Dog handlers talk about the rules for safe bathing of dogs in summer
articles.lead_en: Pets should be accustomed to water gradually, and it is also important to check the shoreline and use a life jacket, the Russian Canine Federation reported.
articles.title_raw: Кинологи рассказали о правилах безопасного купания собак летом
articles.lead_raw: Питомцев стоит приучать к воде постепенно, а также важно проверять береговую линию и использовать спасательный жилет, сообщили в Российской кинологической федерации

articles.title_en: Ukrainian strikes on Russia’s Belgorod region have killed 541 people since the invasion began, acting governor says
articles.lead_en: In an interview with Russia 24‘s local affiliate, Acting Belgorod Governor Alexander Shuvaev said 541 people have been killed in the region since Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine. Another 3,928 people have been wounded, Shuvaev added, noting that the region has come under more than 55,000 attacks by Ukrainian forces.

articles.title_en: The Ministry of Energy expects an increase in energy consumption in the south of the Russian Federation in the summer by 7%
articles.lead_en: A set of measures is being implemented to ensure trouble-free passage of the spring-summer period, which is characterized by increased consumption and high load on the energy system, stressed Energy Minister Sergei Tsivilev

articles.title_en: Russia downs more than 330 Ukrainian drones overnight; apartment building damaged, oil refinery catches fire
articles.lead_en: Debris from Ukrainian drones struck an apartment building in Krasnodar overnight on June 11, Krasnodar Governor Veniamin Kondratyev said. The falling debris sparked a fire in the building, injuring two people.
